title: Explicit equational bases for the power semirings of $S_7$
summary: For every semigroup $S$, the set $\mathcal{P}(S)$ of all subsets of $S$ and the set $\mathcal{P}^{+}(S)$ of all nonempty subsets of $S$ form additively idempotent semirings under set-theoretic union and elementwise multiplication, called the full and nonempty power semirings of $S$, respectively. We investigate the finite basis problem for the full and nonempty power semirings $\mathcal{P}(S_7)$ and $\mathcal{P}^{+}(S_7)$ of the multiplicative reduct of $S_7$, where $S_7$ is the unique nonfinitely based three-element additively idempotent semiring.
